title: Share a shape with an interface
objective: Declare an interface, make classes that do it, and call the method each class provides.

body.text: An interface lists the methods that a kind of object must have, and nothing else. Write interface, then the name, then one can line for each method. A class says it provides the interface with does, and then it writes each method in full. Two classes can share an interface even though their fields and bodies are different.

body.title: Two classes that do the same interface
body.code:
interface drawable
    can draw

class circle does drawable
    can draw
        say "circle"

class square does drawable
    can draw
        say "square"

make c equal to a new circle
make s equal to a new square
draw c
draw s

body.text: An interface does not hold data. If a class needs data for its methods, it declares its own fields with has, just as a class without an interface does.
